fields.formula: M = [AP + EE*(1-W) + B + W*AE] / [EP + EE*(1-W) + B + W*EE] = adjusted actual losses / adjusted expected losses.
fields.formula_summary: NCCI worksheet: actual total J = actual primary I + expected excess C*(1-W) + ballast G + actual excess F*W; expected total K = expected primary E + expected excess C*(1-W) + ballast G + expected excess C*W; experience modifier M = J/K.
fields.expected_loss_build: Expected losses by classification = expected loss rate (ELR) * payroll / 100; expected primary losses = expected losses * D-ratio.
fields.peer_basis: The plan compares an employer's own loss experience with expected losses for similarly classified employers.
fields.limitation: This public methodology reference does not authenticate or calculate a specific insured's factor. A current jurisdiction- and effective-date-specific bureau worksheet and its rating parameters are required.
